name: Kiivo’s White Logo Tee
description: The white globe-bulb T-shirt beneath Kiivo’s navy hoodie. Simple, recognisable, ready for every day.

finish: Chalk white · Navy and gold chest print

name: Leera’s Navy Logo Tee
description: The navy everyday layer from Leera’s wardrobe, finished with a small gold globe-bulb emblem.
materials: Proposed: 200 gsm combed cotton jersey, ribbed crew neck and gold-and-white screen-printed branding.
details: Designed to layer under the teal Explorer Jacket, as worn by Leera. A small logo and wordmark replace oversized artwork. Size charts and final fit require supplier samples.
finish: Midnight navy · Gold and white chest print

name: Kiivo’s Navy Zip Hoodie
description: His signature navy layer: a full zip, practical pockets and a quiet gold chest emblem.
materials: Proposed: 320 gsm cotton-rich brushed fleece, ribbed cuffs and hem, full-length metal zip and embroidered globe-bulb emblem. Final fibre blend to be confirmed.
details: Adult design uses white drawcords and split kangaroo pockets. Youth design must be developed separately without neck drawcords. The named hoodie is the only item included.

name: Leera’s Teal Explorer Jacket
description: The teal jacket she explores in—collared, pocketed and made for carrying a small discovery.
materials: Proposed: 260–280 gsm cotton twill, shirt collar, zip front, patch pockets and gold embroidered globe-bulb emblem.
details: Inspired by Leera’s actual jacket silhouette rather than a printed hoodie. Rollable long sleeves and practical chest pockets. Fabric weight, pocket construction, hardware and fit remain subject to sample approval.

name: Kiivo’s Discovery Backpack
description: A navy backpack for his notebook, pencils and the things he notices along the way.

details: Target capacity 18–20 L. Main compartment, front organiser pocket and bottle pockets with embroidered globe-bulb branding. No portrait patches. Load capacity, strap durability and device fit must be confirmed by sampling; no waterproof claim.

name: Leera’s Explorer Backpack
description: A practical navy-and-teal companion for a journal, measuring tools and a better question.
materials: Proposed: 600D woven polyester outer, polyester lining, padded adjustable straps, mesh bottle pockets and reinforced grab handle.
details: Target capacity 18–20 L, navy base with subtle teal panels or strap details. Small gold globe-bulb branding, practical zipped compartments and no character portrait. Supplier must verify capacity, construction and load performance.
finish: Navy with teal details · Gold embroidery

name: Kiivo’s Idea Notebook

materials: Proposed: A5 cloth-covered hardback, 160 pages of 100 gsm uncoated paper, sewn binding, ribbon marker and elastic closure.
details: Navy cover with restrained gold emblem and small white Innovators World wordmark. Ruled, dot-grid or plain page options. Pencil in the collection image is not included.
finish: Navy hardback · Gold and white cover branding

name: Leera’s Explorer Journal

details: Matches the gold-spiral notebook held in Leera’s reference. Choose dot-grid, ruled or a guided Observe / Question / Reflect layout. Mechanical pencil shown alongside is sold separately.

name: Everyday Innovation Writing Set

finish: Navy / teal / natural wood · Gold details

name: The Innovators World Toolkit
description: Observe something. Measure it. Sketch a possibility. Build a first version. A real toolkit for working through an idea.
materials: Proposed: navy woven zip organiser with teal lining and elastic tool loops; handheld magnifier; 15 cm steel ruler; compact measuring tape; two HB pencils; pen; eraser; A6 sketchbook; sticky-note pad; observation cards; prototyping pack.
details: The prototype pack contains cardboard tabs, paper fasteners, binder clips and wooden craft sticks. No blades, powered components or electronics. Intended as a guided workshop toolset; final age guidance and component specifications follow supplier and programme review. Photograph is a layout proposal; confirm exact pack quantities before sale.
finish: Navy organiser · Teal interior · Gold branding

name: Build & Try Refill Pack
description: Fresh materials for the next small experiment, designed to replenish your toolkit.
materials: Proposed: cardboard tabs and strips, wooden craft sticks, paper fasteners, binder clips, sticky notes and blank observation cards in a kraft paper pack.
details: Consumable prototyping materials only. The organiser, notebook, magnifier and measuring tools pictured with the full toolkit are not included. Supplier quantities and workshop content will be specified before sale.

name: Innovators World Laptop Skin

details: Lid skin only, not a laptop or a protective case. Exact device model and lid measurements are required before producing a cut template. Avoid covering vents, ports, cameras or hinges. Adhesive compatibility and removal behaviour must be tested on the intended finish; no residue-free guarantee is made.

description: A slim everyday brand detail, cut around your phone’s own shape.

finish: Deep teal or navy · Gold emblem
